title: "memhit"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: merging-dfs

library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

data_folder <- file.path(
  Sys.getenv("HOME"),
  "Desktop",
  "data 2"
)

csv_files <- list.files(
  path = data_folder,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

memhit_task <- map_dfr(
  csv_files,
  ~ read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
)

MTQ <- read_csv(
  file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), "Desktop", "MTQ.csv")
)

id_mappings <- read_csv(
  file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), "Desktop", "id_mappings_recent.csv")
)

# Ensure all ID columns are character
id_mappings <- id_mappings |>
  mutate(
    participant_id = as.character(participant_id),
    prolific_pid = as.character(prolific_pid)
  )

memhit_task <- memhit_task |>
  mutate(
    participant = as.character(participant)
  )

MTQ <- MTQ |>
  mutate(participant = as.character(participant))

id_lookup <- bind_rows(
  id_mappings |>
    transmute(
      original_id = participant_id,
      prolific_pid = prolific_pid
    ),
  id_mappings |>
    transmute(
      original_id = prolific_pid,
      prolific_pid = prolific_pid
    )
) |>
  filter(!is.na(original_id)) |>
  distinct()

memhit_task <- memhit_task |>
  left_join(
    id_lookup,
    by = c("participant" = "original_id")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(prolific_pid))

MTQ <- MTQ |>
  left_join(
    id_lookup,
    by = c("participant" = "original_id")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(prolific_pid))

merged_data <- memhit_task |>
  inner_join(
    MTQ,
    by = "prolific_pid",
    suffix = c("_memhit", "_MTQ")
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: cleaning-master-df

merged_data <- merged_data |>
  select(contains("QID6_"),
         prolific_pid,
         Progress,
         `Duration (in seconds)`,
         Finished,
         expCondition,
         boxType,
         outcomeType,
         outcome,
         rewardAmount,
         rewardType,
         rewardProb,
         total_earnings_final,
         avg_report_accuracy,
         hitTask_duration,
         rating_pink,
         rating_blue,
         rating_yellow,
         globalTrial,
         firstPressTime,
         press_count
         ) |>
  mutate(
  across(
    starts_with("QID6_"),
    ~ .x |>
      as.character() |>
      na_if("n/a (Prefer not to answer)") |>
      stringr::str_extract("\\d+") |>
      as.numeric()
  )
) |>
  filter(!is.na(prolific_pid))

merged_data <- merged_data |>
  mutate(personal_mastery = QID6_20 + QID6_14 + QID6_39 + QID6_9 + 
           QID6_21 + QID6_46 - QID6_40 + QID6_15 + QID6_2 + QID6_28,
         competitive_excellence = QID6_41 + QID6_16 + QID6_29 + QID6_23 +
           QID6_35 + QID6_3 + QID6_4 - QID6_17 + QID6_10 + QID6_30 - QID6_11 - QID6_24,
         achievement_anxiety = QID6_42 + QID6_50 + QID6_19 + QID6_48 - QID6_44 - QID6_12 +
           QID6_47 + QID6_37 + QID6_49)

merged_data <- merged_data |>
  mutate(expCondition = na_if(expCondition, "")) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  fill(expCondition, .direction = "down") |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(EV = as.numeric(rewardAmount) * as.numeric(rewardProb)) |>
  mutate(
    reward_level = case_when(
      rewardType %in% "L" & rewardProb == 0.3 ~ "low_p30",
      rewardType %in% "H" & rewardProb == 0.3 ~ "high_p30",
      rewardType %in% "L" & rewardProb == 0.7 ~ "low_p70",
      rewardType %in% "H" & rewardProb == 0.7 ~ "high_p70",
      rewardType %in% "L" & rewardProb == 1 ~ "low_p100",
      rewardType %in% "H" & rewardProb == 1 ~ "high_p100",
    ))
```

```{r}
#| label: EDA
#| warning: FALSE

plot_data <- merged_data |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(prop_press = as.numeric(press_count)/65) |>
  mutate(
    competitive_excellence = first(competitive_excellence),
    personal_mastery = first(personal_mastery),
    achievement_anxiety = first(achievement_anxiety)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(mtq_total = achievement_anxiety + personal_mastery + competitive_excellence)

#would be nice to stratify this by experimental group once we get more data
plot_data |>
  filter(!is.na(reward_level)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = personal_mastery, y = prop_press, color = reward_level)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

plot_data |>
  filter(!is.na(reward_level)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = competitive_excellence, y = prop_press, color = reward_level)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

plot_data |>
  filter(!is.na(reward_level)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = achievement_anxiety, y = prop_press, color = reward_level)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

plot_data |>
  filter(!is.na(reward_level)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mtq_total, y = prop_press, color = reward_level)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```
